mapper.select: SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.RENTAL_ID DESC

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND R.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND R.GUEST_NAME = #{guestName} AND R.GUEST_PHONE = #{guestPhone} AND R.USER_ID = 'GUEST'

SELECT R.RENTAL_ID, R.ITEM_ID, R.USER_ID, R.START_DATE, R.RETURN_DATE, R.RENTAL_STATUS, R.GUEST_NAME, R.GUEST_PHONE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId}
SELECT EXTENSION_ID, EXTENSION_DAYS, PRICE, CREATED_AT, RENTAL_ID FROM RENTAL_EXTENSION WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RENTAL_EXTENSION (EXTENSION_DAYS, PRICE, CREATED_AT, RENTAL_ID) VALUES (#{extensionDays}, #{price}, NOW(), #{rentalId})
mapper.select: SELECT RENTAL_ID AS rentalId, ITEM_ID AS itemId, USER_ID AS userId, START_DATE AS startDate, RETURN_DATE AS returnDate, RENTAL_STATUS AS rentalStatus, GUEST_NAME AS guestName, GUEST_PHONE AS guestPhone, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS pricePerDay, (SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' LIMIT 1) AS imgUrl FROM RENTALS R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.RENTAL_STATUS IN ('IN_USE', 'RESERVED') ORDER BY R.RENTAL_ID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE RENTALS SET RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED', RETURN_ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, RETURN_ADDRESS = #{address}, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS = #{detailedAddress}, RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = NOW() WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND RENTAL_STATUS IN ('IN_USE', 'RESERVED')

UPDATE RENTALS SET RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED', RETURN_ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, RETURN_ADDRESS = #{address}, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS = #{detailedAddress}, RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = NOW() WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND GUEST_NAME = #{guestName} AND GUEST_PHONE = #{guestPhone} AND USER_ID = 'GUEST' AND RENTAL_STATUS IN ('IN_USE', 'RESERVED')
UPDATE DELIVERY SET DELIVERY_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED' WHERE ORDER_ID = ( SELECT OI.ORDER_ID FROM RENTALS R JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} LIMIT 1 )

UPDATE RENTALS SET RENTAL_STATUS = 'IN_USE', RETURN_ZIPCODE = NULL, RETURN_ADDRESS = NULL, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS = NULL, RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = NULL WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED'

UPDATE RENTALS SET RENTAL_STATUS = 'IN_USE', RETURN_ZIPCODE = NULL, RETURN_ADDRESS = NULL, RETURN_DETAILED_ADDRESS = NULL, RETURN_REQUESTED_AT = NULL WHERE RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} AND GUEST_NAME = #{guestName} AND GUEST_PHONE = #{guestPhone} AND USER_ID = 'GUEST' AND RENTAL_STATUS = 'RETURN_REQUESTED'
UPDATE DELIVERY SET DELIVERY_STATUS = 'DONE' WHERE ORDER_ID = ( SELECT OI.ORDER_ID FROM RENTALS R JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT UA.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, UA.ADDRESS AS address, UA.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress FROM USER_ADDRESS UA WHERE UA.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY UA.DEFAULT_YN DESC, UA.ADDRESS_ID ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT D.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, D.ADDRESS AS address, D.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress FROM DELIVERY D JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON D.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID JOIN RENTALS R ON R.ITEM_ID = OI.ITEM_ID WHERE R.RENTAL_ID = #{rentalId} LIMIT 1
